THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: ATU/LND/06/DO48. Reference No. of Ministry of Lands: 4-3/13/2021/PC33. I do hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for the public purpose. EOG 03 - 0251 ______________ THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: KDS/UDB/4/1/1/153. Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation Ref No.: 4-3/3/2018/FR/495. I do hereby give notice. under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the

Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for the public purpose. Description of the land/servitude to be acquired: For the Knuckles Conservation Area. Land depicted as Lot No. 04 in Paper No. 02 in Zone No. 04 in Cadestral Map No. 321379 made by the Surveyor General to the land called Kekulawatta Henyaya situated in 893, Meemure Grama Niladhari Division in Udadumbara Divisional Secretariat Division in the District of Kandy in the Central Province. Claimant: Mrs. Hilda Irangani Gunasekera, No. 21, Darshana, Gemunu Mawatha, Hanthana Place, Kandy. All persons claiming title, rights or other interests in the above land/servitude, are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing appear before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Udadumbara on 09th June, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 02nd June, 2025 of the nature of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
